Name: Vyranity Mega Pack Continued
Author: Shads4242
Description:
[size=5][center]Features[/center][/size]
[list]
[*]42 pastries and desserts added as cooking recipes 
[*]97 jams, pies, and pizzas added as artisan goods 
[*]98 breads and cakes added as either artisan goods [i]or[/i] cooking recipes based on your configuration settings 
[*]custom gift tastes for every item!
[*]4 grain crops 
[*]15 new machines 
[/list]
[center][size=5][b]Changes from the Original [/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*]Tweaked most machine recipes to utilize more common resources to enable earlier access 
[*]Adjusted the processing time of certain machines to balance them out 
[*]Certain machines that have an upgraded form use their base form as a material for crafting. This affects the following recipes:
﻿﻿Stone Bread Oven -> Brick Bread Oven  ﻿Brick Bread Oven -> Modern Bread Oven  ﻿Fruit Smasher -> Modern Fruit Smasher  ﻿Stone Pizza Oven -> Iron Pizza Oven [*]Dropped the word "Filled" from the names of all the fruit pies (ie: Filled Ancient Fruit Pie is now Ancient Fruit Pie) 
[*]Dropped the word "Delicious" from the names of all the cakes (ie: Delicious Ancient Fruit Cake is now Ancient Fruit Cake) 
[*]Added optional compatibility with the butter added by Stardew Valley Expanded and Cornucopia - Artisan Machines
[*]Added a config option to simplify the pizza items added to the mod 
[*]Adjusted certain items' recipes to dynamically utilize either vanilla items or modded items depending on the player's mod loadout. The list of ingredients that adjust this way are as follows
[/list] ﻿ ﻿Mint -> utilizes Cornucopia's Mint if it's available, Fiber if it is not 
﻿ ﻿Cocoa Pod -> utilizes Cornucopia's Cocoa Pod if it's available, Chocolate Cake if it is not 
﻿ ﻿Corn Flour -> utilizes Cornucopia's Corn Flour if it's available, Corn Seeds if it's not 
﻿ ﻿Lemon -> utilizes Cornucopia's Lemon if it's available, Lemon Stone if it's not 
﻿ ﻿Cinnamon -> utilizes Cornucopia's Cinnamon Sticks if it's available, Wood if it's not 
﻿ ﻿Almond -> utilizes Cornucopia's Almond if it's available, Hazelnut if it's not 
﻿ ﻿Peanut -> utilizes Cornucopia's Peanut if it's available, Hazelnut if it's not 

[b][center][size=5]Config Options[/size][/center][/b]
[list]
[*]Enable Breads and Buns - adds the content from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8874]Breads and Buns[/url]. Enabled by default
[*]﻿Enable Cakes and Cream - adds the content from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12244]Cakes and Creams[/url]. Enabled by default 
[*]Enable Puffs and Pastries - adds the content from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16843]Puffs and Pastries[/url]﻿. Enabled by default 
[*]Enable Jams and Pies - adds the content from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9152]Vyranity's Jams and Pies JA[/url]﻿. Enabled by default 
[*]Enable Pizza - adds the content from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9215]Vyranity's Pizza JA[/url]﻿.﻿ Disabled by default 
[*]Breads Chef's Selection - curates the content from Breads and Buns to only add the essentials. Disabled by default, requires Breads and Buns to be enabled
[*]Breads as Artisan Goods - categorizes all breads as artisan goods rather than cooking recipes. Disabled by default, requires Breads and Buns to be enabled
[*]Cakes as Artisan Goods - categorizes all cakes and cake cream as artisan goods rather than cooking recipes. Disabled by default, requires Cakes and Cream to be enabled 
[*]Simple Pizza (new) - curates the content from Pizza to only add whole pizza pies. Disabled by default, requires Pizza to be enabled 
[*]Use Other Butter (new) - allows for any item with the context tag "butter_item" to be used in place of the butter added by this mod 
[*]Use Animal Husbandry - allows for the meats added by Animal Husbandry to be used in certain recipes. Please note that items in the OG mods that did not have Animal Husbandry variants will still use bug meat or bug steak 
[*]Use Rosa's Meats - allows for the meats added by Rosa's Cruelty Free Meats to be used in certain recipes. Please note that items in the OG mods that did not have Fresh Meat for JSON Assets variants will still use bug meat or bug steak 
[*]Use Generic Meat - allows for any item with the context tag "meat_item" to be used in place of bug steak or bug meat. This affects [b]all[/b] meat recipes
[/list][size=5][center][b]Installation and Troubleshooting[/b][/center][/size][b]To Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download the folder from Nexus
[*]unzip the folder and place it in your Mods folder 
[*]launch the game 
[*]use the GMCM to configure the mod
[*]have fun :) 
[/list]
[b]Troubleshooting Question 1: I enabled Breads Chef's Selection/Breads as Artisan Goods, but no bread got added. What happened? 
Answer[/b]: You probably disabled the "Enable Breads and Buns" option. You must enabled the "Enable Breads and Buns" config option for any bread to show up. Both the Chef's Selection and Breads as Artisan Goods build off of this config option to curate how items are added, but you need to enable breads and buns to get the bread items to show up in the first place.

[b]Troubleshooting Question 2: I enabled Cakes as Artisan Goods, but no cakes got added. What happened? 
Answer:[/b] You probably disabled the "Enable Cakes and Cream" option. You must enable the "Enable Cakes and Creams" config option for any of the cakes to show up. Cakes as Artisan Goods builds off of this config option to curate how items are added, but you need to enable cakes and creams to get the cake items to show up in the first place.

[b]Troubleshooting Question 3: I enabled Simple Pizza, but no pizza got added. What happened? [/b]
[b]Answer: [/b]You probably disabled the "Enable Pizza" option. You must enable "Enable Pizza" for the pizza to show up. Simple Pizza builds off of this config option, but it requires "Enable Pizza" to be enabled in order for pizza items to show up in the first place. 

[b]Troubleshooting Question 4: This mod adds butter, but so does this other mod I have. Which butter do I use for recipes? 
Answer:[/b] If you have disabled "Use Other Butters" in the GMCM, you will use the butter from this mod. If you have enabled "Use Other Butters" in the GMCM, you can use any butter provided it has the context tag "butter_item" 

[b]Troubleshooting Question 5: I have "Use Other Butter"/"Use Generic Meat" enabled, and Love of Cooking, but the recipes are showing error items
Answer[/b]: I'm not 100% sure why this is the case. I'm working on a fix for this, but right now it's highly recommended, that you do not use those two config options in conjunction with Love of Cooking. 

[b]Troubleshooting Question 6: I have an issue, how can I get help?
Answer[/b]: If it's something you're unsure about, such as how to make an item, make a post. If it's a bug, make a bug report. Regardless, please include a SMAPI log and your current config settings. This greatly increases the chance of me being able to fix your issue. 

[size=5][center][b]Translations[/b][/center][/size]
If you wish to translate this mod into a different language, you are free to do so. Create an i18n file, upload it to an external website (GitHub, PasteBin, or SMAPI's JSON Validator), and send me the link to that file. I will upload a new version of this mod with your i18n file added to the code. All translators will be credited in their file as well as on the mod page. If you have any further questions regarding translations please dm me. 

Please note that I only speak English, so I cannot do any of the translations myself. 
[b]Current Languages 
[/b]English - Vyranity, Shads42
Japanese -  [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/187540230-oshikawa/]OSHIKAWA[/url]
Italian - [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/flowerssummerr/mods]flowerssummers[/url]
Chinese - [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sora6949/mods]sora6949[/url]

[size=5][center][b]Future Plans[/b][/center][/size]
At this time I have few plans to add anything new to this mod. Maintenance updates (bugfixes, framework upgrades, translation additions, etc) will be performed, but there is little chance of any new content being added. The most that I could see happening is a perfection toggle, a progression system, and a machine version for puffs and pastries (similar to how breads and buns or cakes and creams has that artisan good toggle). These are all [b]far[/b] in the future though.
